name: MER Tx ML Patient List 2019
description: MER Tx ML Patient List 2019 - List of patients with documented medical eligibility (CD4 or WHO Stage) for ART initiation

baseCohortDefinition.name: Base Cohort for MER Tx ML Patient List 2019

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%' OR uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.patient_id = o.person_id AND pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d') AND pp.date_enrolled <= o.obs_datetime AND pp.voided = 0)

rowFilter.name: Base Cohort for MER Tx ML Patient List 2019

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%' OR uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.patient_id = o.person_id AND pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d') AND pp.date_enrolled <= o.obs_datetime AND pp.voided = 0)

SELECT pi.identifier FROM patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = :patientId AND pi.identifier_type = (SELECT patient_identifier_type_id FROM patient_identifier_type WHERE uuid = '7faf6b56-08a4-4c06-bc31-3a12f17bd05b') AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CONCAT(given_name, ' ', family_name) FROM person_name WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY preferred DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT gender FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthdate, :endDate) FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId

SELECT value FROM person_attribute WHERE person_id = :patientId AND person_attribute_type_id = (SELECT person_attribute_type_id FROM person_attribute_type WHERE uuid = 'a640f592-7c09-4b4e-b0e0-1f53b0354aba') AND voided = 0

SELECT MIN(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%' OR uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0

SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%pregnant%' OR name LIKE '%pregnant%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%tb%' OR name LIKE '%tb%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%') AND o.value_numeric < 500 AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%stage iii%' OR name LIKE '%stage iii%' OR uuid LIKE '%stage iv%' OR name LIKE '%stage iv%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d') AND pp.date_enrolled >= (SELECT MIN(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%' OR uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) AND pp.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d') AND pp.date_enrolled >= (SELECT MIN(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%cd4%' OR name LIKE '%cd4%' OR uuid LIKE '%who stage%' OR name LIKE '%who stage%') AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM person_address WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY date_created DESC LIMIT 1
